videos.title: Radio Wales Breakfast
videos.description: Everything you need to know as you wake up.

videos.title: Money for Nothing
videos.description: Your dedications and song requests from the 1950s-90s. Can you guess the Stuck in the Middle song? Text 81012, email moneyfornothing@bbc.co.uk or call 03700 100 110.

videos.title: Radio Wales Sport
videos.description: Live commentary from Twickenham as Wales take on Japan in the Nations Championship, followed by the latest around the football grounds.

videos.title: Welsh Wonders (The Hit Makers)
videos.description: Huw Stephens presents two hours of brilliant live music as he delves into the BBC Archive for rare versions of some of Wales's greatest songs, both onstage and in session.

videos.title: Bethan Elfyn
videos.description: Bethan shares live music from Spanish Horses at S?n Festival, Three of a Kind on the theme of Grand Theft Auto 6, and brilliant new Welsh releases in The Wales Mix.

videos.title: BBC Introducing with Adam Walton
videos.description: Adam shares Gwenno's live set from Cardiff Music City Festival 2026. Twst discuss their track Little Deaths, plus more from The New Breed.

videos.title: Relax with Radio Wales
videos.description: Relax, unwind and chill out with an hour of classic and contemporary tunes.

videos.title: As BBC Radio 5 Live
videos.description: See listings for BBC Radio 5 Live on BBC Sounds.

videos.title: Radio Wales Arts Show
videos.description: Alfred Janes: Maker of Pictures by Ceri Thomas examines his work and life. Hilly Janes gives a more personal account of her father, and the dark comedy Silent Night, Raging Eve.

videos.title: Man Alive
videos.description: Shining a light on the growing mental health crisis among men in the UK. We dismantle the barriers that prevent men from seeking help.

videos.title: Country Focus
videos.description: Programme for everyone living in the countryside and tackling the issues affecting them.

videos.title: Celebration
videos.description: Dominic Jewel and friends lead an advent Celebration from around a fire as they reflect on the Shepherds in the nativity story.

videos.title: Sunday Supplement
videos.description: Vaughan Roderick with political news, discussions and analysis.

videos.title: All Things Considered
videos.description: Azim Ahmed and guests explore the harder side of Advent, from loneliness and bereavement to finding comfort, hope and connection at Christmas.

videos.title: Owen Money's Solid Gold Sunday
videos.description: A second dose of Owen Money for the weekend. It's nonstop music all the way, with classics from the 60s, 70s and 80s, plus your dedications.

videos.title: Radio Wales Sport
videos.description: Live commentary of Swansea City v Cardiff City.

videos.title: Lynn Bowles
videos.description: Music, entertainment and great guests for your Sunday afternoon.

videos.title: Roy Noble
videos.description: Join Roy as he chats with Caerphilly musician Wrenna and talks folklore and festive traditions with 'cyfarwydd' storyteller Ceri John Phillips.

videos.title: Jacko's Sporting Amanac
videos.description: 1/3. Peter Jackson recalls the triumph and tragedy of one of Wales's greatest all-round sportsman: Maurice Turnbull.

videos.title: Celebration
videos.description: Dominic Jewel and friends lead an advent Celebration from around a fire as they reflect on the Shepherds in the nativity story.

videos.title: Celtic Heartbeat
videos.description: Frank Hennessy presents the best in folk, roots and acoustic music from the Celtic countries and beyond.

videos.title: Beverley's World of Music
videos.description: The finest musical melodies, exquisite performances from stage and screen, and orchestral and choral works from Wales and the world. There's no need to book your seat, just listen and relax.

videos.title: As BBC Radio 5 Live
videos.description: See listings for BBC Radio 5 Live on BBC Sounds.

videos.title: Radio Wales News Update
videos.description: The latest news from Wales and the world.

videos.title: Wake Up with Radio Wales
videos.description: A lively mix of music to start the day. Perfect for your pod.

videos.title: Radio Wales Arts Show
videos.description: Alfred Janes: Maker of Pictures by Ceri Thomas examines his work and life. Hilly Janes gives a more personal account of her father, and the dark comedy Silent Night, Raging Eve.

videos.title: Radio Wales Breakfast
videos.description: Everything you need to know as you wake up.

videos.title: Bronwen Lewis
videos.description: Bronwen brightens your morning with great music and entertainment. Call 03700 100 110 Text 81012 or message via X @bbcradiowales.

videos.title: The Phone In
videos.description: Be part of the nation's conversation.

videos.title: Behnaz Akhgar
videos.description: Celebrity guests, TV Turn Ons, and we test your anagram-solving skills with The Name Game. Call or WhatsApp 03700 100 110 Text 81012.

videos.title: Radio Wales Drive
videos.description: Everything you need to know as you head home.

videos.title: Jacko's Sporting Amanac
videos.description: 2/3. 11 Welshmen helped win the Ashes for England. Joining English Rugby League players on an aircraft carrier just after World War II to return victorious. Relatives help tell the tale.

videos.title: Huw Stephens
videos.description: Huw Stephens plays classic tracks with hits from Blur, Little Simz and Gorky's Zygotic Mynci, plus new Welsh music for you to sink your teeth into on your Monday evening.

videos.title: Eleri Siôn
videos.description: Eleri brightens your night-time with great music and chat. Call 03700 100 110 Text 81012 or via X @bbcradiowales.
